dublin_core_group.title: 2021 Miami-Dade NLCD Impervious Surfaces
dublin_core_group.license_text:

dublin_core_group.description: NLCD Urban Imperviousness is a 30 m raster geospatial dataset that is available for the conterminous United States. They are generated by the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS), in partnership with several federal agencies. These data provide spatially explicit and reliable information on the Nation’s land cover and land cover change. NLCD imperviousness products represent urban impervious surfaces as a percentage of developed surface over every 30-meter pixel in the United States.

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/download -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# load us_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces as dependency (see us_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces for details).

# clip raster with geometry as:
  gdalwarp -cutline PG:"<postgres connection>" -csql "SELECT geom FROM fl_2022_tl_cousub WHERE countyfp='086'" -crop_to_cutline -s_srs '+proj=aea +lat_0=23 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=29.5 +lat_2=45.5 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs' -t_srs EPSG:4326 /data/us_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/download/Annual_NLCD_FctImp_2021_CU_C1V1.tif download/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces.tif
 
#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# load raster into postGIS with:
    raster2pgsql -s 4326 -d -C -I -t 48x48 mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces.tif -F mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces > load_raster.sql
psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
rm load_raster.sql

# create color raster
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
cat > /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_color_ramp.txt <<_EOF
nv 0 0 0 0
255 255 255 255 0
100 158 31 235 255
90 197 79 235 255
80 235 130 235 255
70 235 57 57 255
60 234 81 81 255
50 232 104 104 255
40 223 121 121 255
30 221 146 146 255
20 219 168 168 255
10 210 184 184 255
1 209 209 209 255
0 255 255 255 0
_EOF
gdaldem color-relief download/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces.tif /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_color_ramp.txt /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_color.tif -alpha
# create color raster and render raster tiles 
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived
mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
echo "" | base64 -d > /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_legend.png
cp /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_legend.png /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/
# render raster tiles 
cd /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/
gdal2tiles.py -ex --xyz -z 8-16 /data/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces/derived/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces_color.tif /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_nlcd_impervious_surfaces
